title.zh: 我笔记本电脑上的 Qwen 3.8 27B 也能解读模型权重
title.en: Qwen 3.8 27B on my laptop can interpret model weights, too

current_state.zh:
Simon Willison 报告称，他在自己笔记本电脑上本地运行的 Qwen 3.8 27B 能够解读原始模型权重，复现了 Rikiya Takehi、Jayden Teoh、Alex Zhang 与 Omar Khattab 合著的论文《Sparks of Weight-Space Programming: LLMs can natively read & write neural network weights》中的一个示例。该论文此前是以 GPT-6 Astra 等前沿模型展示这一能力的。

这一演示表明，无需工具即可读取权重的能力并不局限于 GPT-6 Astra 等前沿系统——一个在笔记本上运行的开放权重模型复现了论文中的一个示例。不过它仍属于探索性的博客复现，而非正式成果或同行评审结论。

论文的第一个实验训练了四个神经网络，让它们玩 10x10 网格版的 Breakout、Pong、Pac-Man 和 Freeway，随后把权重以浮点数形式交给大模型，并说明模型没有工具、不能执行代码、只有一次回答机会，要求其判断每个网络是为哪款游戏训练的。Willison 聚焦于这个“无工具”问题，并提到批评者 Matthew Honnibal 与 Sean Goedecke 对论文将借助代码编辑模型的做法归入同一概念提出质疑。
current_state.en:
Simon Willison reported that Qwen 3.8 27B, running locally on his laptop, could interpret raw model weights in a replication of an example from the paper "Sparks of Weight-Space Programming: LLMs can natively read & write neural network weights" by Rikiya Takehi, Jayden Teoh, Alex Zhang and Omar Khattab. That paper had demonstrated the capability with frontier models, specifically GPT-6 Astra.

The demonstration indicates that no-tools weight reading is not confined to frontier systems such as GPT-6 Astra, since an open-weight model running on a laptop reproduced one of the paper's examples. It remains an exploratory blog-post replication rather than a formal result or peer-reviewed finding.

The paper's first experiment trained four neural networks to play 10x10 grid versions of Breakout, Pong, Pac-Man and Freeway, then supplied the weights as floating-point numbers to an LLM with the instruction that it had no tools, no code execution and a single response to identify which game each network was trained on. Willison focused on this no-tools question, noting that critics Matthew Honnibal and Sean Goedecke disputed the paper's framing of code-assisted model editing.

updates.background_zh: 权重空间编程（Weight-Space Programming）指通用大模型在不使用梯度下降或训练循环的情况下，读取、解读并直接写入另一个神经网络的权重；该术语由 Takehi 等人的论文提出，作者本人将其归类为博客文章。GPT-6 Astra 是 OpenAI 的前沿模型，于 2026 年 9 月 3 日向获批用户开放。Qwen 3.8 27B 是 Qwen 推出的开放权重稠密视觉语言模型，基于 Qwen3.5 架构构建。
updates.background_en: Weight-space programming refers to a general-purpose LLM reading, interpreting and directly writing another neural network's weights without gradient descent or a training loop; the term was coined in the Takehi et al. paper, which the authors classify as a blog post. GPT-6 Astra is OpenAI's frontier model, released to approved users on September 3, 2026. Qwen 3.8 27B is an open-weight dense vision-language model from Qwen built on the Qwen3.5 architecture.
updates.market_impact_zh: 该成果属于开放权重模型研究与本地推理范畴，并不涉及任何代币或协议，因此对加密资产没有直接传导路径；若有影响，也仅通过围绕开放权重与去中心化 AI 叙事的情绪面体现。它是一项解读性演示，而非产品或网络层面的变更。
updates.market_impact_en: The result concerns open-weight model research and local inference rather than any token or protocol, so there is no direct transmission to crypto assets; any effect would run only through sentiment around open-weight and decentralized-AI narratives. It is an interpretive demonstration, not a product or network change.
